q1_what_did_you_play: I played Powder Pop first to gain 1 Spark, then Jumpy Dumpty, then Kaboom! at Nibbit, then Ka-pow! at Nibbit. This used all 3 energy and prioritized direct damage while also placing two Bombs.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Powder Pop, Kaboom!, Duck and Cover, and Ka-pow! because it would still use the Spark and add 5 Block, but it gave up Jumpy Dumpty's 16 direct damage and its 6-damage Bomb for only 5 Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up Duck and Cover's 5 Block and any defensive value, leaving the player to take the telegraphed 12 damage. It also relied on Ka-pow! becoming playable after Powder Pop's Spark gain, and it placed two Bombs whose damage timing is not fully specified by the page.
q4_different_intent: No. The telegraphed 12 Attack is far below 62 HP, and the only defensive card available gives only 5 Block, so a non-lethal intent would not make the defensive line worth giving up Jumpy Dumpty and the extra Bomb.
